name: D1 Local - Your Agent Decides On Its Own
description: Runs typed boolean/choice/score decisions locally on Apple Silicon. Your OpenClaw agent queries a preloaded LiquidAI d1-Omni model over loopback: no cloud API, no per-token bill, state stays on your machine. One-command setup, 26/26 contract-tested, launchd-managed.

baseUrl.description: Loopback /v1/decisions endpoint of the local d1 system_one runner.

autoHeal.description: Re-bootstrap the launchd decision units on gateway startup and when the runner becomes unreachable (scripts/ensure-services.sh).

breakerThreshold.description: Consecutive transport failures before the provider fails fast instead of waiting for the timeout each time.

breakerCooldownMs.description: How long the provider stays fail-fast after its circuit breaker trips.

healThrottleMs.description: Minimum gap between self-heal attempts in milliseconds.
